description: Defines a user's selection of columns and rows for a replica.

columnSelection.description: Each SelectionId is an arr node's id from the 'columnOrder' array

rowSelection.description: Each SelectionId is an arr node's id from the 'rows' array

columnSelectAll.description: When true, all columns are selected and 'columnSelection' will be ignored.

rowSelectAll.description: When true, all rows are selected, and 'rowSelection' will be ignored.
